ALTER PROC [DW].[SP_CI_Deposits_Retail] AS
BEGIN

IF EXISTS(SELECT [name] FROM sys.tables WHERE [name] like 'CI_Deposits_Retail') 
BEGIN
   DROP TABLE  DW.CI_Deposits_Retail;
END;


WITH DimCustomerAccount_DEP AS
(
    SELECT
        DCA.AccountID ,DCA.CustomerID ,DCA.SourceSystemCode ,DCA.ValidStartDate ,DCA.CustomerSK ,DCA.BankSK ,DCA.BranchSK ,DCA.AccountSK ,DA.AccountOpenedDate, DB.BankID,DCA.ShareIndicator
    FROM DW.DimCustomerAccount DCA
    LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccount DA ON DCA.AccountSK = DA.AccountSK
    LEFT JOIN DW.DimBank DB ON DCA.BankSK = DB.BankSK 
    WHERE DCA.SourceSystemCode = 'DEP' AND DCA.CurrentIndicator = '1'
    GROUP BY DCA.AccountID ,DCA.CustomerID ,DCA.SourceSystemCode ,DCA.ValidStartDate ,DCA.CustomerSK ,DCA.BankSK ,DCA.BranchSK ,DCA.AccountSK ,DA.AccountOpenedDate, DB.BankID,DCA.ShareIndicator
  
)


SELECT 
     DCA.AccountID
    ,DCA.CustomerID
    ,CASE WHEN DC.GlobalCIF IS NOT NULL THEN REPLACE(DC.GlobalCIF,'Global_CIF_','Entity_CIF_')
      ELSE CONCAT('Entity_CIF_', DC.SourceSystemCode, '_', DC.CustomerID) END AS EntityCIF
    ,DCA.BankID AS BankCode
    ,DBr.BranchID AS BranchCode
    ,DBr.BranchName AS BranchName
    ,DBr.Area
    ,DBr.Region
    ,DCA.SourceSystemCode AS Source
    ,DP.ProductGroup AS ProductGrouping
    ,CONCAT(DP.ProductGroup,'-',DP.ProductName) AS ProductDetails
    ,DP.ProductName AS ProductType
    ----,DP.FcbsApplication AS Application ----This column does not exist in DIM PRODUCT
    ,DCA.AccountOpenedDate AS OpenedDate
    ,DCA.ShareIndicator 
    ,CASE WHEN DCA.ShareIndicator = 'Y' THEN FADMTD.AverageDailBalanceAmountMTDFull ELSE 0 END AS MonthToDateAverageDailyBalance_Full
    ,CASE WHEN DCA.ShareIndicator = 'Y' THEN FADMTD.AverageDailBalanceAmountMTDProrated ELSE 0 END AS MonthToDateAverageDailyBalance_Prorated
    ,CASE WHEN DCA.ShareIndicator = 'Y' THEN FADYTD.AverageDailBalanceAmountYTDFull ELSE 0 END AS YearToDateAverageDailyBalance_Full
    ,CASE WHEN DCA.ShareIndicator = 'Y' THEN FADYTD.AverageDailBalanceAmountYTDProrated ELSE 0 END AS YearToDateAverageDailyBalance_Prorated
    ,CASE WHEN DCA.ShareIndicator = 'Y' THEN FDOB.BalanceAmountFull ELSE 0 END AS OutstandingBalance_Full
    ,CASE WHEN DCA.ShareIndicator = 'Y' THEN FDOB.BalanceAmountProrated ELSE 0 END AS OutstandingBalance_Prorated
    ,CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,FDOB.BusinessDateSK)) AS BusinessDate
    ,DCA.ValidStartDate AS LastUpdatedDate
    ,CONCAT(DCA.AccountId,DCA.CustomerID,DCA.BankID,DCA.SourceSystemCode) as AccountKey 
    INTO DW.CI_Deposits_Retail
FROM DimCustomerAccount_DEP DCA
JOIN (SELECT CustomerSK ,GlobalCIF,SourceSystemCode,CustomerID FROM DW.DimCustomer  WHERE CustomerType = 'Retail' AND CurrentIndicator = '1') DC ON DCA.CustomerSK = DC.CustomerSK
LEFT JOIN (SELECT AccountSK,ProductSK FROM DW.DimAccountProduct WHERE CurrentIndicator = '1') DAP ON DCA.AccountSK = DAP.AccountSK
LEFT JOIN (SELECT BranchSK ,BranchID ,BranchName ,Area ,Region FROM DW.DimBranch  WHERE CurrentIndicator = '1') DBr ON DCA.BranchSK = DBr.BranchSK
LEFT JOIN (SELECT ProductSK ,ProductGroup ,ProductName FROM DW.DimProduct  WHERE CurrentIndicator = '1') DP ON DAP.ProductSK = DP.ProductSK
LEFT JOIN (SELECT AccountSK ,AverageDailBalanceAmountMTDFull ,AverageDailBalanceAmountMTDProrated FROM DW.FactAverageDailyBalanceMTD  WHERE BusinessDateSK = (SELECT MAX(BusinessDateSK) FROM DW.FactAverageDailyBalanceMTD )) FADMTD ON DCA.AccountSK = FADMTD.AccountSK ----NO DATA
LEFT JOIN (SELECT AccountSK ,AverageDailBalanceAmountYTDFull ,AverageDailBalanceAmountYTDProrated FROM DW.FactAverageDailyBalanceYTD WHERE BusinessDateSK = (SELECT MAX(BusinessDateSK) FROM DW.FactAverageDailyBalanceYTD )) FADYTD ON DCA.AccountSK = FADYTD.AccountSK ----NO DATA
LEFT JOIN (SELECT AccountSK ,BalanceAmountFull ,BalanceAmountProrated,BusinessDateSK FROM DW.FactDepositsOutstandingBalance WHERE BusinessDateSK = (SELECT MAX(BusinessDateSK) FROM DW.FactDepositsOutstandingBalance ))  FDOB ON DCA.AccountSK = FDOB.AccountSK ----NO DATA
--LEFT JOIN 
--(SELECT A.AccountSK ,BalanceAmountFull ,BalanceAmountProrated, A.BusinessDateSK 
--FROM DW.FactDepositsOutstandingBalance A
--LEFT JOIN  (SELECT AccountSK, MAX(BusinessDateSK) BusinessDateSK FROM DW.FactDepositsOutstandingBalance  GROUP BY AccountSK )  B ON A.AccountSK = B.AccountSK
--WHERE A.BusinessDateSK = B.BusinessDateSK) FDOB ON DCA.AccountSK = FDOB.AccountSK ----NO DATA
where DCA.ShareIndicator = 'Y'
GROUP BY
DCA.AccountID
,DCA.CustomerID
,DC.GlobalCIF
,DCA.BankID
,DBr.BranchID
,DBr.BranchName
,DBr.Area
,DBr.Region
,DCA.SourceSystemCode
,DP.ProductGroup
,DP.ProductName
,DCA.AccountOpenedDate
,FADMTD.AverageDailBalanceAmountMTDFull
,FADMTD.AverageDailBalanceAmountMTDProrated
,FADYTD.AverageDailBalanceAmountYTDFull
,FADYTD.AverageDailBalanceAmountYTDProrated
,FDOB.BalanceAmountFull
,FDOB.BalanceAmountProrated
,FDOB.BusinessDateSK
,DCA.ValidStartDate
,DC.SourceSystemCode
,DC.CustomerID
,DCA.ShareIndicator

END
GO

ALTER PROC [DW].[SP_CI_Deposit_Corporate] AS
BEGIN

IF EXISTS(SELECT [name] FROM sys.tables WHERE [name] like 'CI_Deposit_Corporate') 
BEGIN
   DROP TABLE  DW.CI_Deposit_Corporate;
END;


WITH DimCustomerAccount_DEP AS
(
    SELECT
        DCA.AccountID ,DCA.CustomerID ,DCA.SourceSystemCode ,DCA.ValidStartDate ,DCA.CustomerSK ,DCA.BankSK ,DCA.BranchSK ,DCA.AccountSK ,DA.AccountOpenedDate ,DB.BankID,DCA.ShareIndicator
    FROM DW.DimCustomerAccount DCA
    LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccount DA ON DCA.AccountSK = DA.AccountSK
    LEFT JOIN DW.DimBank DB ON DCA.BankSK = DB.BankSK 
    WHERE DCA.SourceSystemCode = 'DEP' AND DCA.CurrentIndicator = '1' AND DB.BankID IN ('CBC01', 'CBC11')
     GROUP BY DCA.AccountID ,DCA.CustomerID ,DCA.SourceSystemCode ,DCA.ValidStartDate ,DCA.CustomerSK ,DCA.BankSK ,DCA.BranchSK ,DCA.AccountSK ,DA.AccountOpenedDate, DB.BankID,DCA.ShareIndicator
)

SELECT DISTINCT
    DCA.AccountID
    ,DCA.CustomerID
    ,CASE WHEN DC.GlobalCIF IS NOT NULL THEN REPLACE(DC.GlobalCIF,'Global_CIF_','Entity_CIF_')
      ELSE CONCAT('Entity_CIF_', DC.SourceSystemCode, '_', DC.CustomerID) END AS EntityCIF
    ,DCA.BankID AS BankCode
    ,DBr.BranchID AS BranchCode
    ,DBr.BranchName AS BranchName
    ,DBr.Area
    ,DBr.Region
    ,DCA.SourceSystemCode AS Source
    ,DP.ProductGroup AS ProductGrouping
    ,DP.ProductName as ProductType
    ,CONCAT(DP.ProductGroup,'-',DP.ProductName) AS ProductDetails
    ----,DP.FcbsApplication AS Application ----This column does not exist in DIM PRODUCT
    ,DCA.AccountOpenedDate AS OpenedDate
    ,CASE WHEN DCA.ShareIndicator = 'Y' THEN FADMTD.AverageDailBalanceAmountMTDFull ELSE 0 END AS MonthToDateAverageDailyBalance_Full
    ,CASE WHEN DCA.ShareIndicator = 'Y' THEN FADMTD.AverageDailBalanceAmountMTDProrated ELSE 0 END AS MonthToDateAverageDailyBalance_Shared
    ,CASE WHEN DCA.ShareIndicator = 'Y' THEN FADYTD.AverageDailBalanceAmountYTDFull ELSE 0 END AS YearToDateAverageDailyBalance_Full
    ,CASE WHEN DCA.ShareIndicator = 'Y' THEN FADYTD.AverageDailBalanceAmountYTDProrated ELSE 0 END AS YearToDateAverageDailyBalance_Shared
    ,CASE WHEN DCA.ShareIndicator = 'Y' THEN FDOB.BalanceAmountFull ELSE 0 END AS OutstandingBalance_Full
    ,CASE WHEN DCA.ShareIndicator = 'Y' THEN FDOB.BalanceAmountProrated ELSE 0 END AS OutstandingBalance_Shared
    ,FDOB.BusinessDateSK AS BusinessDate
    ,DCA.ValidStartDate AS LastUpdatedDate
    ,CONCAT(DCA.AccountId,DCA.CustomerID,DCA.BankID,DCA.SourceSystemCode) as AccountKey    
    INTO DW.CI_Deposit_Corporate
FROM DimCustomerAccount_DEP DCA
JOIN (SELECT CustomerSK ,GlobalCIF,SourceSystemCode,CustomerID FROM DW.DimCustomer WHERE CustomerType = 'Corporate') DC ON DCA.CustomerSK = DC.CustomerSK
LEFT JOIN (SELECT AccountSK,ProductSK FROM DW.DimAccountProduct) DAP ON DCA.AccountSK = DAP.AccountSK
LEFT JOIN (SELECT BranchSK ,BranchID ,BranchName ,Area ,Region FROM DW.DimBranch) DBr ON DCA.BranchSK = DBr.BranchSK
LEFT JOIN (SELECT ProductSK ,ProductGroup ,ProductName FROM DW.DimProduct) DP ON DAP.ProductSK = DP.ProductSK
LEFT JOIN (SELECT AccountSK ,AverageDailBalanceAmountMTDFull ,AverageDailBalanceAmountMTDProrated FROM DW.FactAverageDailyBalanceMTD  WHERE BusinessDateSK = (SELECT MAX(BusinessDateSK) FROM DW.FactAverageDailyBalanceMTD )) FADMTD ON DCA.AccountSK = FADMTD.AccountSK
LEFT JOIN (SELECT AccountSK ,AverageDailBalanceAmountYTDFull ,AverageDailBalanceAmountYTDProrated FROM DW.FactAverageDailyBalanceYTD WHERE BusinessDateSK = (SELECT MAX(BusinessDateSK) FROM DW.FactAverageDailyBalanceYTD )) FADYTD ON DCA.AccountSK = FADYTD.AccountSK
LEFT JOIN (SELECT AccountSK ,BalanceAmountFull ,BalanceAmountProrated,BusinessDateSK FROM DW.FactDepositsOutstandingBalance WHERE BusinessDateSK = (SELECT MAX(BusinessDateSK) FROM DW.FactDepositsOutstandingBalance ))  FDOB ON DCA.AccountSK = FDOB.AccountSK ----NO DATA
--LEFT JOIN (SELECT A.AccountSK ,BalanceAmountFull ,BalanceAmountProrated, A.BusinessDateSK 
--FROM DW.FactDepositsOutstandingBalance A
--LEFT JOIN  (SELECT AccountSK, MAX(BusinessDateSK) BusinessDateSK FROM DW.FactDepositsOutstandingBalance  GROUP BY AccountSK )  B ON A.AccountSK = B.AccountSK
--WHERE A.BusinessDateSK = B.BusinessDateSK) FDOB ON DCA.AccountSK = FDOB.AccountSK ----NO DATA
GROUP BY
DCA.AccountID
,DCA.CustomerID
,DC.GlobalCIF
,DCA.BankID
,DBr.BranchID
,DBr.BranchName
,DBr.Area
,DBr.Region
,DCA.SourceSystemCode
,DP.ProductGroup
,DP.ProductName
,DCA.AccountOpenedDate
,FADMTD.AverageDailBalanceAmountMTDFull
,FADMTD.AverageDailBalanceAmountMTDProrated
,FADYTD.AverageDailBalanceAmountYTDFull
,FADYTD.AverageDailBalanceAmountYTDProrated
,FDOB.BalanceAmountFull
,FDOB.BalanceAmountProrated
,FDOB.BusinessDateSK
,DCA.ValidStartDate
,DC.SourceSystemCode
,DC.CustomerID
,DCA.ShareIndicator

END
GO
